facts.statement: Earth's volumetric mean radius is 6,371.000 km and GM is 0.39860 x 10^6 km^3/s^2 (398,600 km^3/s^2).

Dropped into a straight frictionless tunnel through a uniform Earth, you reach the far end in pi*sqrt(R^3/GM) = 2,530 s = 42.2 minutes, about 42 minutes, and the time is the same for any straight tunnel between two surface points, not only one through the centre.

inputs.model: straight frictionless tunnel through a uniform-density, non-rotating Earth, no air; gravity inside grows linearly with distance from the centre (simple harmonic motion)

facts.statement: Falling through a tunnel through the centre, your top speed, reached at Earth's centre, is sqrt(GM/R) = 7.91 km/s, about 28,000 km/h.

inputs.model: straight frictionless tunnel through a uniform-density, non-rotating Earth, no air; gravity inside grows linearly with distance from the centre (simple harmonic motion)

facts.statement: A satellite orbiting just above the surface (no air) would take 2*pi*sqrt(R^3/GM) = 84.3 minutes per orbit, so it travels halfway round in the same ~42 minutes as the tunnel drop.

inputs.model: straight frictionless tunnel through a uniform-density, non-rotating Earth, no air; gravity inside grows linearly with distance from the centre (simple harmonic motion)

facts.statement: The 'Blue Marble' photo of Earth was taken by the Apollo 17 crew in December 1972.

source.title: View of the Earth as seen by the Apollo 17 crew (as17-148-22727)
